name: dsh-web-tools
description: Unified multi-provider web search and fetch for DeepSeek Harness — BYOK, per-provider credential pools, quota & health monitoring, deterministic fallback, native settings UI, and self-hosted search
author: A3Boy

scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('lib',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsdown && npm run build:bridge
scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test test/version-check.test.ts test/routing-policy.test.ts test/source-routing.test.ts test/bridge.test.ts test/xiaohongshu.test.ts test/x.test.ts test/dom-fixtures.test.ts test/platform-integration.test.ts src/host/logic.test.ts test/section-registration.test.ts test/status-logic.test.ts test/search-mode.test.ts test/provider-contracts.test.ts test/tool-registry.integration.test.mjs test/fetch-proxy.test.mjs test/routes.smoke.mjs test/runtime.test.mjs
scripts.smoke: node --experimental-strip-types --test test/version-check.test.ts test/routing-policy.test.ts test/source-routing.test.ts test/bridge.test.ts test/xiaohongshu.test.ts test/x.test.ts test/dom-fixtures.test.ts test/platform-integration.test.ts test/section-registration.test.ts test/status-logic.test.ts test/search-mode.test.ts test/tool-registry.integration.test.mjs test/fetch-proxy.test.mjs test/routes.smoke.mjs test/runtime.test.mjs
